F-16 is also a major Foreign Military Sales platform (Taiwan, Poland, Slovakia, Bulgaria, Romania, Bahrain Block 70 lines), so demand for HEICO PMA replacement parts has a long tail beyond just the US Air Force RDT&E PE. scores.claim_text: ETG TWTAs and MPMs are predominately used in radar, electronic warfare, on-board jamming and countermeasure systems in aircraft, ships and detection platforms deployed by U.S. and allied non-U.S. military forces.
supports: pentagon_jbook 'electronic warfare': 3 matches; primary PE 0207040F Multi-Platform Electronic Warfare Equipment = UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS (FY24 $14.3M → FY25 $0 → FY26 $0)

pentagon_jbook 'radar': 5 matches; primary PE 0102417F Over-the-Horizon Backscatter Radar = UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR (FY24 $471M → FY25 $377M → FY26 $0); but PE 0604873C Long Range Discrimination Radar (Lockheed) and PE 1203873SF BMD Radars still in corpus (mixed)
pentagon_jbook 'countermeasure': PE 0302315F Non-Kinetic Countermeasure Support = FUNDED_STEADY ($7M/yr)
scores.interpretation: HEI's claim is broad — 'EW, jamming, countermeasure on aircraft/ships' is so diversified that individual PE shutdowns (Multi-Platform EW Equipment zeroed; OTH-B Radar zeroed in FY26 after $377M FY25) only nick the franchise. Materiality test (heuristic 2): HEI does not name these specific PEs as material customers; the company sells subcomponents (TWTAs/MPMs) that go into many EW/radar platforms. Heuristic 6: USAspending confirms HEI received real DoD contracts (~$187M), so past revenue is real but specific named PEs are shrinking. Score MODERATE — narrative-load-bearing but diversified across many platforms; not existential.

scores.M_value: Tranche 3 Transport Layer UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS — but replacement_program = 'Space Data Network (SDN) Backbone / Space Link'
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 3 (reorganization caveat): Tranche 3 Transport Layer was zeroed but replaced by SDN — so funding moved, not disappeared. Rad-hard memory demand for the broader SDA architecture survives even though the specific PE went away. HEI sells parts (memory chips, microwave passives) into many sat/spacecraft programs, not just SDA, so impact is diluted. Score MODERATE — there is real budget reshuffling in defense space (proliferated LEO architecture pivot), and HEI customers may need re-qualification cycles, but not existential. NOT_FOUND on SDA-Tracking-Layer-by-name is a corpus gap.

scores.claim_text: ETG derived ~51% of net sales in FY2025/2024 and 49% in FY2023 from sale to U.S./foreign military, prime defense contractors, and defense satellite/spacecraft manufacturers. ETG is 30% of total HEI net sales in FY25 (so defense ≈ 15% of total HEI sales).
supports: USAspending: HEICO has 5,463 DoD awards totalling $186.8M obligated — confirms DoD presence
Top awards include Robertson Fuel Systems (HEICO ETG subsidiary) self-sealing fuel system IDIQs ($41M, $22M, $18M, $12M, etc.)
DoD revenue concentration steady FY23→FY25 (49% → 51% → 51% of ETG); not growing pathologically
Total HEI sales $4,485M FY25 — implied defense ETG sales ~$686M, materially above any single PE risk
scores.M_value: $186.8M / 5,463 awards / diversified across many platforms; concentration steady not growing
scores.interpretation: Defense concentration is steady not accelerating, and is spread across 5,463 awards (no single-program existential dependency). The $186.8M in USAspending lines vs. company-stated ~$686M ETG defense revenue gap is expected — most HEI defense revenue is sub-tier (selling to primes who are the named recipient), not direct DoD prime. Materiality test (heuristic 2) → ETG is just 30% of HEI and only 51% of ETG is defense, so any single PE loss is ~ <1% revenue impact even before considering the diversification within. PASS.

summary.key_finding: HEICO is the diversification-as-defense case. The 10-K names broad capability categories (TWTAs/MPMs, EW, missile-seeker simulation, self-sealing fuel systems, rad-hard memory) but does NOT name specific Program Elements (PE numbers) or specific programs of record as material revenue drivers. The framework finds individual PE shutdowns (PE 0207040F Multi-Platform EW Equipment UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS; PE 0102417F OTH-B Radar FY26 zeroed; PE 1206410SF Tranche 3 Transport Layer reorged into SDN; PE 1203873SF BMD Radars FY26 zeroed) but HEI's footprint is sufficiently broad (5,463 DoD awards, $186.8M obligated, 51% of just-30%-of-revenue exposure to defense, diversified across many primes/platforms) that no single PE loss creates an existential signal. F-16 Squadrons (only explicitly named platform) is FUNDED_GROWING. The J-Book divergence pattern this cohort is built to detect — small-cap that names a single PE as material → PE is zeroed — does not fit HEICO; HEICO is the diversified prime-supplier mirror image of the IonQ/YSS short thesis.
